name: Portable USB Mini Turbo Washer | Ultrasonic Travel Washing Machine for Socks, Underwear & Dishes
description:
The Portable USB Mini Turbo Washer is a smart solution for washing small loads like socks, underwear, baby clothes, towels, and even dishes. Using ultrasonic high-frequency vibration, it removes dirt and stains effectively while saving time, water, and energy. Its compact, lightweight design makes it perfect for travel, dorms, and outdoor use. USB-powered and easy to operate, this washer ensures quick and convenient cleaning anywhere.
Key Features
 Ultrasonic cleaning with powerful vibration technology
 Compact, lightweight & portable design
 USB powered for convenience & energy saving
 Multi-purpose: laundry, towels, rags & dishes
 Easy to use with any bucket, sink, or basin
How to Use
 Place washer in a bucket or sink with water
 Add detergent and laundry or dishes
 Connect USB power to start ultrasonic cleaning
 Rinse items after cycle and dry as usual
Material
Durable ABS plastic + electronic ultrasonic motor
Safety Information
 Do not run without water
 Keep away from children during operation
 Avoid immersing USB port in water
Package Includes
 1 × Portable USB Mini Turbo Washer
